annotations.title: Grade a feed against the Agentic Commerce Protocol

description: Grade a product feed against the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) / OpenAI product feed specification, which governs whether a catalog can be sold inside ChatGPT. Takes the feed URL (XML or JSON) and returns a 0-100 score plus per-attribute findings on required and recommended fields. Use this when asked whether a catalog or feed is ready for agentic commerce, for ChatGPT Instant Checkout, or for ACP compliance in general.

url.description: Public URL of the product feed (XML or JSON).
